features.title: Everything a bazaar needs
features.subtitle: From registration to the cash count – for everyone involved.
features.docs: Step-by-step guides for organizers and sellers are in the <docs>documentation</docs>.

camera.title: Quick item entry
camera.text: With or without a photo, with extra fields like size or frame number – one item after another with “Create & add another”.

layers.title: Several bazaars
layers.text: Offer an item at several bazaars, also in bulk.

printer.title: Labels as PDF
printer.text: Large or small, with your seller number – one by one or all at once.

badgePercent.title: Discounts
badgePercent.text: Lower prices during the bazaar – without a new label, from the time the organizer sets.

handshake.title: Price offers & negotiating
handshake.text: Accept or decline offers from buyers, or set a minimum price for the cash desk.

messagesSquare.title: Answer questions
messagesSquare.text: Answer questions from interested buyers right on the item.

radio.title: Live status & reminders
radio.text: See what has sold, and get all drop-off details by email the evening before. You choose which emails you get.

idCard.title: Digital ID
idCard.text: Drop-off and pickup with one scan.

calculator.title: Fees clear upfront
calculator.text: Commission and intake fee with a worked example before you register.

calendarPlus.title: Create a bazaar with a wizard
calendarPlus.text: Pick a bike sale, kids' bazaar or flea market: suitable settings are preset, and each step explains them.

slidersHorizontal.title: Your rules per bazaar
slidersHorizontal.text: Discounts, price offers, negotiating, photos, required details and items per seller.

keyRound.title: Control registration
keyRound.text: Seller limit, access code, public or private.

mapIcon.title: Site map & locations
mapIcon.text: Define areas like “Hall B” so visitors find items.

users.title: Helpers
users.text: Make participants helpers for intake, checkout and settlement with one click.

packageCheck.title: Intake by scan
packageCheck.text: One by one or all items of a seller at once, with an internal note for the team.

smartphone.title: Checkout with a cart
smartphone.text: Scan all items of a buyer – with the phone camera or a hand scanner – and take payment once.

userPlus.title: Walk-in sellers
userPlus.text: Create spontaneous sellers without an account on site and accept their items right away.

wallet.title: Settlement & returns
wallet.text: Commission, intake fee and payout calculated automatically, unsold items returned in order.

megaphone.title: Keep sellers informed
megaphone.text: Messages to all sellers, plus automatic emails the evening before and for pickup.

search.title: Find bazaars
search.text: Public bazaars with all the information.

clipboardCheck.title: Browse items in advance
clipboardCheck.text: Items with photos and prices even before the bazaar.

scanLine.title: Scan on site
scanLine.text: Price, discount and location straight from the QR code.

handCoins.title: Make an offer
handCoins.text: Make an offer online during the bazaar if the bazaar allows price offers.

messageCircleQuestionMark.title: Ask questions
messageCircleQuestionMark.text: Ask publicly on the item, e.g. about size or condition.

receipt.title: Get a receipt
receipt.text: One receipt for the whole purchase by email, or a private invoice as PDF.

seo.title: BazarPro – free software for clothing bazaars, bike sales and flea markets
seo.description: Run a children's clothing bazaar, bike sale or flea market digitally: sellers enter items online and print QR labels, the checkout scans with a smartphone, and the settlement is created automatically. Free and open source.

hero.line1Start: Sellers list their items at home
hero.line2Start: At the bazaar, you just scan –

cta.title: Ready for your next bazaar?
cta.text: Create your bazaar or sign up as a seller – for free.
cta.openSource: BazarPro is open source (MIT) – <github>code on GitHub</github>

events.title: Upcoming events
events.text: Discover public events near you and start selling right away.
events.empty: No public bazaars are planned right now
events.emptyText: Organizing one? Create it in a few minutes – sellers will find it here.

process.title: From the basement to the payout
process.text: Using an old bike as an example: one QR code follows the item from the listing to the settlement.

photo.title: Take a photo & list it
photo.description: Photograph the old bike from the basement, set a price and register it for the bazaar.

tag.title: Attach the QR label
tag.description: BazarPro creates the labels as a PDF. Print them, attach them to the item and bring it to the bazaar.

checkIn.title: Drop-off
checkIn.description: At drop-off the label is scanned – from now on the item is available and has its spot.

sell.title: Scan & sell
sell.description: Visitors scan the QR code for price and location. At the checkout, a scan with your own phone is all it takes.

settlement.title: Cash count
settlement.description: Sales, commission and payout are settled for every seller – no lists, no recounting.

pickup.title: Collect money & items
pickup.description: Sellers see their settlement on their phone and collect their money and unsold items with their digital pass.

scenes.noPrice: No price on the label – discounts are possible at any time.
scenes.booked: Booked – the seller sees it live
scenes.scanHint: One scan of the pass shows all your own items.

instance.seoDescription: Register and sell your items at {{name}}.
instance.text: Register your items online, print the labels and keep track of your sales.

meta.defaultDescription: Free open-source software for children's clothing bazaars, bike sales and flea markets: QR labels, smartphone checkout, automatic settlement.
meta.appDescription: Open-source software for second-hand bazaars such as children's clothing bazaars, bike sales, ski bazaars and flea markets: register items online, print QR labels, scan at the checkout with a smartphone, automatic settlement.
